what: Track-02 supervised fine-tuning of the 19.3M sparse MoE on task-shaped data
objective: next-token prediction with the prompt masked (-100), i.e. answer-only loss. The first two runs were invalid: run 1 appended <|pad|> as EOS (token_to_id('</s>') is None), and run 2 compared logits[t] to labels[t] instead of labels[t+1] — it learned to copy the input and scored 0.07 CE while generating nothing.

result.note: stopped at 100/250 steps: machine load averaged 15, throughput fell to 0.03 it/s

qualitative.learned: the Track-02 answer shape — e.g. 'Nature 寒, flavours 甘, channels not recorded, toxicity 無毒, grade …'
qualitative.not_learned: the values. Given an unseen herb the model emits a plausible STRUCTURE with wrong entries; and on long passage-conditioned prompts (the demo's retrieval path) the SFT model is no better than the base model, so the demo keeps the base checkpoint
qualitative.honest_read: this is format learning, not domain knowledge. It makes the model usable as a task interface; it does not make it an expert.

decision.why: the strongest measured results are drug-discovery statements (78/203 physics refutations, 28 → 10 → 18 funnel, 60 candidates with kill criteria); track 01 becomes supporting evidence; tracks 03/04 are thin — see docs/TRACK.md
decision.effect: the model is fine-tuned on Track-02 tasks; the deck and video lead with the filter and the arbiter
